Data:Departure.assistance.longer.json.label: Departing Assistance
Data:Departure.assistance.longer.json.desc: Someone's time is up, and now they're going home.

Data:Desk.repair.cracked.json.label: Repair a Cracked Binding
Data:Desk.repair.cracked.json.startdescription: The joints and hinges creak, but the spine holds firm.
Data:Desk.repair.cracked.json.desc: The cracked binding is restored. The book opens cleanly as wings.

Data:Deskhint.json.label: At a Desk
Data:Deskhint.json.startdescription: At a desk, you can write and decipher documents. Add Ink to write them; add Soul and Skill cards to change your approach.

Data:Device.json.label: Device
Data:Device.json.desc: A machine that will only operate once. If it's an infernal device, that means it'll explode, so be careful.

Data:Didumos.json.Label: Didumos
Data:Didumos.json.Desc: No Star is permitted upon Earth, but we may cozen them to dream of us, and the Dream of a Star may take a kind of form, which we call didumos.' - Thomas Dewulf

Data:Difficulty.keeper.json.label: Keeper-level Challenges
Data:Difficulty.keeper.json.desc: Available only to the wise, the great, or the most fortunate of idiots. [For the most challenging recipes, provide fifteen degrees of the relevant Aspect. Every Keeper-level recipe also needs a very specific ingredient - the perfect ingredient may even mean you need less Aspect.].

Data:Difficulty.oddities.json.label: Difficulty: Oddity
Data:Difficulty.oddities.json.desc: [A relevant Aspect at this level gives you a chance of finding an oddity.]

Data:Difficulty.prentice.json.label: Prentice-level Challenges
Data:Difficulty.prentice.json.desc: The simpler techniques require skill alone. [For basic recipes, provide five degrees of the relevant Aspect].

Data:Difficulty.rarities.json.label: Difficulty: Rarities
Data:Difficulty.rarities.json.desc: [A relevant Aspect at this level gives you a chance of finding a rarity.]

Data:Difficulty.scholar.json.label: Scholar-level Challenges
Data:Difficulty.scholar.json.desc: More advanced techniques require power as well as significant skill. [For more challenging recipes, provide ten degrees of the relevant Aspect. Every Scholar-level recipe also needs an ingredient with a specific Aspect.].

Data:Disassemble.carcass.necropsy.json.label: Saw Up a Carcass
Data:Disassemble.carcass.necropsy.json.startdescription: Reduce something unique to something useful. [This will break the object down into Animal Bones.]

Data:Disassemble.wooden.workbench.json.startdescription: Reduce something unique to something useful. [This will break the object down into Wooden Scraps.]

Data:Disassemble.woven.workbench.json.label: Break Down a Woven Object
Data:Disassemble.woven.workbench.json.startdescription: Reduce something unique to something useful. [This will break the object down into Rags.]

Data:Disc.fishes.json.Label: Twinned-Fish Stone
Data:Disc.fishes.json.Desc: This stone disc is lighter than it should be; and the surface is soapy-smooth.

xexts.scrutiny: A memorial stone preserved from Ys, the city behind the sea…

Data:Dispose.foundry.wisp.agdistis.json.label: Dispose of the Wisp
Data:Dispose.foundry.wisp.agdistis.json.startdescription: The wisp begins to wriggle, pulling away from the heat, mewing like a broken-winged gull.
Data:Dispose.foundry.wisp.agdistis.json.desc: The wisp's cries cease instantly. Its residue creeps across the blazing meniscus like rapid fungus - but then that movement ceases, until it congeals into splattered patterns with the qualities of script or hierograms.

Data:Dispose.foundry.wisp.ehsan.json.desc: The wisp's cries cease instantly. Its residue creeps across the blazing meniscus like rapid fungus - but then that movement ceases, until it congeals into splattered patterns with the qualities of script or hierograms.

Data:Dissipating.json.desc: (recipe aspect) - removes or sets ready for retirement temporary conditions (like dampness) - xpans at dawn

Data:Dist.json.label: Dist
Data:Dist.json.desc: Distributing, pouring out, likely candidate for renaming

Data:Distributable.json.label: To Serve -
Data:Distributable.json.desc: Use a store of glasses or cups to pour this out.

Data:Do.record.edge.json.label: Make a Determination: Speech, the Sword
Data:Do.record.edge.json.startdescription: Language is a weapon. With language, we breached the Mansus; without language, we could not have fought wars; without language, we would still be apes, beetles, stone. [Adds Edge and Grail to your journal; replaces any other Speech Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.edge.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering an Edge History, the First Flower: White Determination is relevant; or if you're considering a Grail History, Oldest: Grail is relevant.]

Data:Do.record.forge.json.label: Make a Determination: Red, the First Flower
Data:Do.record.forge.json.startdescription: The Watchman's Tree is the covenant that forbids knowledge to mortals, but permits it in the covenant-houses of the Tree... like Brancrug Isle.The Red Flower of Calyptra -'the fire fuelled by truth' was its first defence. Fire consumes knowledge... but fire also gives light. The Tree is rooted in paradox. [Adds Forge and Rose to your journal; replaces any other First Flower Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.forge.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering a Forge History, the From-Nowhere Origin is relevant; or if you're considering a Rose History, Speech the Key is relevant.]

Data:Do.record.grail.json.label: Make a Determination: Grail, Oldest
Data:Do.record.grail.json.startdescription: The Red Grail gives life; the Grail takes life; the Grail is not sated. The Grail, who disdains contradiction, is the oldest Hour that persists. Any that seem older are subsumed, eventually, in the Grail's tides. [Adds Grail and Nectar to your journal; replaces any other Oldest Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.grail.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering a Grail History, Speech the Sword is relevant; or if you're considering a Nectar History, Origin: Roots is relevant.]

Data:Do.record.heart.json.label: Make a Determination: Horned-Axe, Oldest
Data:Do.record.heart.json.startdescription: The Horned-Axe bears two blades; permits passage when passage is to be permitted; waits at the threshold. The Horned-Axe, who forbids contradiction, is the oldest Hour. Other Hours might seem older. They are not older. [Adds Heart and Knock to your journal; replaces any other Oldest Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.heart.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering a Heart History, the Origin: Shell Determination is relevant; or if you're considering a Knock History, Speech the Wound is relevant.]

Data:Do.record.knock.json.label: Make a Determination: Speech, the Wound
Data:Do.record.knock.json.startdescription: Language is a scar. It was language that tore open the Mansus; without language, we could have had no wars; without language, we would still be fire, sky, earth. [Adds Knock and Winter to your journal; replaces any other Speech Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.knock.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering a Knock History, the Oldest: Horned-Axe Determination is relevant; or if you're considering a Winter History, First Flower: White is relevant.]

Data:Do.record.lantern.json.label: Make a Determination: Glorious Origin
Data:Do.record.lantern.json.startdescription: Our first sparks of self descended from the light above the world which we call the Glory. Without the Glory, we would be beasts in darkness, and the gifts of our past illuminate our future, which is Eternity [Adds Moth and Lantern to your journal; replaces any other Origin Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.lantern.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering either a Moth or a Lantern History, the Origin: Glorious and Oldest: Moth Determinations are both relevant.]

Data:Do.record.moon.json.label: Make a Determination: Black, the First Flower
Data:Do.record.moon.json.startdescription: The Watchman's Tree is the covenant that forbids knowledge to mortals, but permits it in the covenant-houses of the Tree... like Brancrug Isle.The Black Flower of Calyptra -'the night unwounded' - was its first defence. Forbidden knowledge must not be spoken; must not be written; must not be known. The Tree is rooted in night. [Adds Moon and Scale to your journal; replaces any other First Flower Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.moon.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering a Moon History, the Origin: Roots Determination is relevant; or if you're considering a Scale History, Origin: Shell is relevant.]

Data:Do.record.moth.json.label: Make a Determination: Moth, Oldest
Data:Do.record.moth.json.startdescription: The Moth beats within the skull; seeks among the trees of the Wood; is dappled. The Moth, who delights in contradiction, is the oldest Hour that remains. Any that seem older, the Moth once was, when once it was. [Adds Moth and Lantern to your journal; replaces any other Oldest Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.moth.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering either a Moth or a Lantern History, the Origin: Glorious and Oldest: Moth Determinations are both relevant.]

Data:Do.record.nectar.json.label: Make a Determination: Roots Origin
Data:Do.record.nectar.json.startdescription: Our ancestors were born naked in the roots of the Wood. All we ever were has risen from that darkness. With our hands and our mouths we shaped language from mud. With our mouths and our hands we will shape our future. [Adds Nectar and Moon to your journal; replaces any other Origin Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.nectar.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering a Nectar History, the Oldest: Grail Determination is relevant; or if you're considering a Moon History, First Flower: Black is relevant.]

Data:Do.record.rose.json.label: Make a Determination: Speech, the Key
Data:Do.record.rose.json.startdescription: Language is the key. It was language that opened the doors of the Mansus; without language, we could have had no peace; without language, we would still be beasts, worms, mud. [Adds Rose and Sky to your journal; replaces any other Speech Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.rose.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering a Rose History, the First Flower: Red Determination is relevant; or if you're considering a Sky History, Origin: From-Nowhere is relevant.]
